title: VibeMaxxing planning task catalog
description: The source of docs/planning/TASK_CATALOG.md. The program and step blocks are generated from this file by scripts/repository/generate_planning_docs.py. The rendered `Status:` line is what validate_repair_task_binding.py parses to decide whether a step may claim completion while it still owns unlanded units, so the status vocabulary is constrained here rather than left to prose.

status.description: COMPLETION_CLAIMS in validate_repair_task_binding.py refuses `complete`, `closed`, `done` and `resolved` while a step owns unlanded units or unclosed findings. `in-progress-planning` and `blocked-planning` claim nothing.

body.description: Markdown rendered verbatim beneath the heading and status line. Must not contain a level-4 heading: the steps are nested under P-1140F, and a `####` here would make a step's block part of a program's body, which is how the first extraction duplicated all five steps.
